description: This file defines the FrameFilter class, a specialized processor within the Pipecat framework that filters frames based on their types to control data flow through the pipeline.

classes.name: FrameFilter
classes.description: A frame processor that filters frames based on their types, allowing only specified types and automatically allowing system and end frames.

methods.name: __init__(self, types: Tuple[Type[Frame], ...])
methods.description: Initializes the FrameFilter with a tuple of frame types to allow through the filter.

methods.name: _should_passthrough_frame(self, frame)
methods.description: Determines whether a given frame should pass through the filter based on its type.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes an incoming frame, applying filtering logic and passing it along if appropriate.

ctags.name: process_frame
ctags.pattern: /^    async def process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection):$/
